declared_input_requirements.raw_genomic_files: inventory-only; raw hard-called SNP contents are not parsed

missing_input_rules: If metadata is absent, allow dry-run technical planning but block population-label interpretation.
If only one file from a paired/trio format is declared, flag missing companion files.
If hard-called SNP inputs are absent, do not select this recipe.
preflight_checks: Confirm raw genomic files remain inventory-only.
Require human expert review before interpreting PCA, relatedness, outlier, ADMIXTURE, FST, ROH, or selection outputs.

dry_run_steps.title: Inventory hard-called SNP inputs
dry_run_steps.description: Record declared PLINK, PED/MAP, or PGEN/PVAR/PSAM path/name inventory without parsing raw genotype contents.

dry_run_steps.title: Preview sample and SNP QC
dry_run_steps.description: Render dry-run missingness, heterozygosity, HWE, relatedness, and outlier caution notes.

dry_run_steps.title: Preview LD pruning and PCA
dry_run_steps.description: Render non-executed LD pruning and PCA previews plus report artifact expectations.

command_preview_templates.description: Dry-run preview for hard-called SNP QC.
command_preview_templates.preview: plink --bfile {declared_plink_prefix} --missing --het --hardy --out {dry_run_prefix} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.

command_preview_templates.description: Dry-run preview for LD pruning and PCA.
command_preview_templates.preview: plink --bfile {declared_plink_prefix} --indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2 --out {dry_run_prefix}; smartpca -p {dry_run_parfile} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.

allowed_with_review: Hard-called SNP PCA workflow planning can be previewed for human review.
soften: Convert PCA, relatedness, outlier, ROH, and FST assertions into cautious review notes.
block: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components

blocked_interpretations: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components
scientific_validity_notes: Dry-run command previews do not imply that PLINK, ADMIXTURE, smartpca, vcftools, or any external genomics tool was executed.
external_llm_called=false by default; external_tools_executed=false; raw genomic files are inventory-only.
Hard-called SNP PCA requires QC, LD pruning, relatedness/outlier caution, metadata context, and human expert review before interpretation.
human_review_checklist: Human expert review required: confirm paired/trio inputs, build, missingness, relatedness, LD pruning, and metadata.
Confirm PCA clusters are not identity labels and ADMIXTURE components are not literal ancestry.
Confirm clinical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, consumer ancestry, caste/community/religion, genetic purity/superiority, unsupported selection, and unsupported endogamy claims are blocked.
